<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Untuk Iin</title>
<script>document.documentElement.classList.add("js")</script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,500;1,9..144,400&family=Nunito:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f8eef3; --bg2:#f0dcea; --ink:#3a2145; --soft:#7a5a86; --accent:#c2456b; --line:#e6cfdd; --stars:0;
  color-scheme:light; box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#14112b; --bg2:#231c4a; --ink:#f1e9f7; --soft:#b9a8d0; --accent:#f08aa8; --line:#352f63; --stars:1; color-scheme:dark}
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#14112b; --bg2:#231c4a; --ink:#f1e9f7; --soft:#b9a8d0; --accent:#f08aa8; --line:#352f63; --stars:1; color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{
  margin:0; color:var(--ink); font-family:"Nunito",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:17px; line-height:1.7;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg2) 100%) fixed; background-color:var(--bg);
  transition:background-color .8s,color .8s; overflow-x:hidden;
}
main{position:relative; z-index:1; max-width:560px; margin:0 auto; padding:44px 24px 64px; text-align:center}
h1,h2{font-family:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif; font-weight:500; line-height:1.2; margin:0}
h1{font-size:2.4rem; margin-top:30px}
h2{font-size:1.65rem; margin-bottom:12px}
p{margin:0 0 14px}
.soft{color:var(--soft)}

/* Latar: hati melayang & bintang */
.fx{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden}
.heart{position:absolute; bottom:-40px; color:var(--accent); opacity:0; animation:rise linear infinite}
@keyframes rise{
  0%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0); opacity:0}
  12%{opacity:.5} 88%{opacity:.3}
  100%{transform:translate(34px,-112vh) rotate(24deg); opacity:0}
}
.stars{position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:var(--stars); transition:opacity 1.2s}
.star{position:absolute; width:3px; height:3px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; animation:twinkle 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.15; transform:scale(.7)} 50%{opacity:1; transform:scale(1.3)}}

/* Foto */
.frame{
  display:block; width:240px; height:310px; margin:0 auto; position:relative;
  border-radius:120px 120px 20px 20px; overflow:hidden; border:3px solid var(--accent);
  animation:bloom 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both, float 6s ease-in-out 1.4s infinite, glow 4s ease-in-out 1.4s infinite;
}
.frame img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:50% 42%; display:block}
@keyframes bloom{from{opacity:0; transform:scale(.8) translateY(20px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
@keyframes glow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(194,69,107,.0), 0 10px 30px rgba(194,69,107,.18)} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(194,69,107,.08), 0 14px 40px rgba(194,69,107,.32)}}
.hello{animation:fade 1s ease .7s both}
.sub{animation:fade 1s ease 1.1s both}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
.beat{display:inline-block; color:var(--accent); animation:beat 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes beat{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)} 15%{transform:scale(1.25)} 30%{transform:scale(1)} 45%{transform:scale(1.18)}}

section{margin-top:56px; padding-top:40px; border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.js .rv{opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px); transition:opacity .9s ease, transform .9s ease}
.js .rv.in{opacity:1; transform:none}

.wrap{position:relative; display:inline-block}
button.go{font:inherit; font-weight:600; color:#fff; background:var(--accent); border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:12px 28px; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s}
button.go:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
button.go:active{transform:scale(.96)}
button.go:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:3px}
.pop{position:absolute; left:50%; top:0; color:var(--accent); pointer-events:none; animation:pop 1.1s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(.6)} to{opacity:0; transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx)),-70px) scale(1.2)}}

.gombal{min-height:7.4em; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin:8px 0 18px;
  font-family:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1.35rem; line-height:1.5; transition:opacity .25s}
.gombal.out{opacity:0}
.rest-msg{min-height:3.4em; color:var(--accent); font-family:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1.25rem; transition:opacity .8s}
.moon{display:block; font-size:2.6rem; margin-bottom:6px; animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite}
footer{margin-top:48px; font-size:.9rem; color:var(--soft)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{animation:none !important; transition:none !important}
  .js .rv{opacity:1; transform:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="fx" aria-hidden="true"><div class="stars" id="stars"></div><div id="hearts"></div></div>

<main>
  <div class="frame"><img alt="Foto Iin" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"></div>
  <h1 class="hello">Untuk Fitri atriani adikk akuu,yang paling aku sayang, paling gemes , yang paling kusayang <span class="beat" aria-hidden="true">♥</span></h1>
  <p class="soft sub">Halaman kecil ini dibuat khusus untukmu.</p>

  <section class="rv">
    <h2>Terima kasih</h2>
    <p>Terima kasih sudah sabar, sudah selalu ada, dan sudah jadi tempat paling nyaman untuk pulang.</p>
    <p>Kamu mungkin tidak sadar, tapi hari-hariku terasa lebih ringan karena ada kamu.</p>
    <p>kamuu adalahh orang yang paling penting di hidup aku,</p>
    <P>jadi kamu kalau ada apa apa bilang yaa sama akuu kamu jangan memendemnya sendiri okeyy</P>
    <p>aku akan selalu ada buat kamu meskipin kamu lagi gak mood atau lagi gamau ku aku di temenin</p>
  </section>

  <section class="rv">
    <h2>Sedikit gombal</h2>
    <div class="gombal" id="gombal" aria-live="polite">Ketuk tombol di bawah, ada yang mau kubisikkan.</div>
    <div class="wrap" id="wrap"><button class="go" id="next" type="button">Gombalin aku</button></div>
  </section>

  <section class="rv">
    <span class="moon" aria-hidden="true">🌙</span>
    <h2>Istirahat yaaa sayangkuu</h2>
    <p>jangan terlalu banyak aktivitas yaa kamu.</p>
    <p>Hari ini kamu sudah melakukan aktivitas pasti kamu sangat cape sekarang juga cuacanya lagi panas banget .</p>
    <p>Perbanyak minum air putih ya biarga dehidrasi</p>
    <div class="rest-msg" id="rest" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <button class="go" id="night" type="button">Selamat malam</button>
  </section>

  <footer>Dibuat dengan sepenuh hati.</footer>
</main>

<script>
(function(){
  function rnd(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a)}

  // hati melayang
  var hs = document.getElementById("hearts");
  for (var k=0;k<14;k++){
    var h = document.createElement("span"); h.className="heart"; h.textContent="♥";
    h.style.left = rnd(2,96)+"%"; h.style.fontSize = rnd(12,26)+"px";
    h.style.animationDuration = rnd(11,20)+"s"; h.style.animationDelay = (-rnd(0,18))+"s";
    hs.appendChild(h);
  }
  // bintang
  var st = document.getElementById("stars");
  for (var s=0;s<36;s++){
    var d = document.createElement("span"); d.className="star";
    d.style.left = rnd(0,100)+"%"; d.style.top = rnd(0,100)+"%";
    d.style.animationDelay = (-rnd(0,3))+"s"; d.style.animationDuration = rnd(2.2,4.5)+"s";
    st.appendChild(d);
  }

  // muncul saat di-scroll
  var rv = document.querySelectorAll(".rv");
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window){
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
      es.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
    },{threshold:.15});
    rv.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else { rv.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add("in"); }); }

  // gombal
  var lines = [
    "Bedanya kamu sama kopi: kopi bikin aku melek, kamu bikin aku susah tidur karena kepikiran terus.",
    "Kalau kamu jadi bintang, aku rela begadang tiap malam hanya untuk memandangimu.",
    "Capek ya? Sini, bersandar saja di pikiranku. Di situ selalu ada kamu.",
    "Aku tidak butuh mimpi indah, karena kenyataan sudah ada kamu.",
    "Kamu itu seperti Wi-Fi: begitu kamu dekat, hatiku langsung terhubung.",
    "Hari ini boleh lelah, tapi ingat ya: ada aku yang selalu bangga padamu.",
    "Senyummu itu seperti charger: bikin aku penuh lagi setelah seharian habis."
  ];
  var last=-1, g=document.getElementById("gombal"), wrap=document.getElementById("wrap");
  document.getElementById("next").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var n; do { n=Math.floor(Math.random()*lines.length); } while(n===last);
    last=n; g.classList.add("out");
    setTimeout(function(){ g.textContent="“"+lines[n]+"”"; g.classList.remove("out"); },250);
    for (var p=0;p<7;p++){
      var o=document.createElement("span"); o.className="pop"; o.textContent="♥";
      o.style.setProperty("--dx", rnd(-70,70)+"px"); o.style.animationDelay=(p*0.05)+"s";
      wrap.appendChild(o); (function(x){ setTimeout(function(){ x.remove(); },1400); })(o);
    }
  });

  // mode malam
  var root=document.documentElement, rest=document.getElementById("rest"), night=document.getElementById("night"), dark=false;
  night.addEventListener("click", function(){
    dark=!dark; root.setAttribute("data-theme", dark?"dark":"light");
    night.textContent = dark ? "Kembali terang" : "Selamat malam";
    rest.style.opacity = 0;
    setTimeout(function(){
      rest.textContent = dark ? "Tidur yang nyenyak ya, adikkk. Aku sayang kamu." : "";
      rest.style.opacity = 1;
    },300);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
